title: Make persistent task cluster service test more stable

timeline.message: Make persistent task cluster service test more stable
timeline.author: Benjamin Trent

timeline.body:
Previously, it was possible to have:

 - both threads start
 - One sits in the submit update task
 - The other has not even scheduled to run yet
 - Latch counts down
 - Thread 1 finishes, allowing another submit task
 - Thread 2 now gets scheduled and ran and submits a cluster update request

Fixes #76337

I have incorporated this test fix in both backports: 

https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/76314
https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/76315
LGTM! I think it totally makes sense to start the 2nd thread only after first has been submitted
Should this now be exactly once instead of at least once?  If not, please add a comment to say why there might be more than one.

reply.body: @droberts195 the `atLeastOnce` is because these `verify` checks are also present after the test has ran. If I did `1` time only, the test would fail because there is a valid execution later (when both have finished executing making sure the atomicboolean is unset).

timeline.body: LGTM2, although it would be good if you could bring the comments up to date so future maintainers don't get confused
I think this needs a backport to 7.x too?
@henningandersen the original backports of the first PR included this fix.
